answer: The canyon test I would run is Proof of unique farmers-market vendor license: a license with stall fees paid across seasons, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a license with stall fees paid across seasons cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the basalt of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the mirror of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
